title: Inference with Many Weak Instruments and Heterogeneity
text: package mwivhet implements procedure valid inference many instrumental variable (IV) model many weak instruments heterogeneous treatment effects, based Yap (2026). leading application setting examiner design, judge caseworker indicators instruments. setting, number instruments can large relative sample size. Existing inference procedures, Mikusheva Sun (2022) Matsushita Otsu (2022), robust many weak instruments assume homogeneity treatment effects. Yap (2026) shows procedures need control type error, therefore incorrect size, heterogeneity. package implements procedure Yap (2026), uses novel leave-three-(L3O) variance estimator correct size asymptotically uniformly powerful unbiased many weak instruments heterogeneous treatment effects. point estimator unbiased jackknife IV estimator (UJIVE) Kolesár (2013), removes -observation dependence applying leave-one-construction instrument coefficients covariate adjustment estimated excluding observation ii fitted value constructed entirely observations. monotonicity condition Imbens Angrist (1994), UJIVE can interpreted weighted average causal effects individuals whose treatment affected instrument. monotonicity fails, estimand remains well-defined. confidence interval obtained inverting Lagrange Multiplier (LM) test, test statistic uses novel leave-three-(L3O) variance estimator consistent even reduced-form coefficients consistently estimable.

title: Inference with Many Weak Instruments and Heterogeneity
text: demonstrate package using suffolk dataset, contains administrative records Suffolk County District Attorney’s Office. dataset obtained Agan, Doleac, Harvey (2023), study effect misdemeanor prosecution recidivism, measured criminal complaint two years. Following Agan, Doleac, Harvey (2023), paper frames prosecution treatment; treatment variable XiX_i coded indicator immediate non-prosecution (ng_immed_all), complement, outcome YiY_i indicator criminal complaint two years (anyr_twoyears_arrest2). Instruments ZiZ_i prosecutor indicators (first_pros), covariates WiW_i constructed court--year court--day--week combinations.

title: Inference with Many Weak Instruments and Heterogeneity
code: library(mwivhet) library(dplyr) library(fixest) # 0. Setup ---------------------------------------------------------------- df <- suffolk  # 1. Preparation ---------------------------------------------------------- # 1.1. Variable Assignment df <- df %>%   mutate(     X = ng_immed_all,     Y = anyr_twoyears_arrest2,     groupZ = first_pros   )  # 1.2. Construct Covariate Groups (groupW) df <- df %>%   mutate(     monthID = as.integer(factor(court_month2)),     dowID   = as.integer(factor(court_dow2)),     groupW  = as.integer(factor(paste(dowID, monthID, sep = "_")))   )  # 1.3. Construct Interaction Groups (groupQ / group) df <- df %>%   mutate(     groupQ = as.integer(factor(paste(groupW, groupZ, sep = "_"))),     group  = groupQ   )  # 1.4. Filter for Group Size df <- df %>%   group_by(groupQ) %>%   filter(n() >= 4) %>%   ungroup()  # 1.5. Get residualized objects lmX <- fixest::feols(X ~ 1 | group, data = df) df$MX <- lmX$residuals  lmY <- fixest::feols(Y ~ 1 | group, data = df) df$MY <- lmY$residuals

title: Compute Quadratic Coefficients for Confidence Sets (Grouped Data) — GetCIcoef
text: confidence set constructed inverting test statistic based quadratic form \(Q(\beta) = (\mathbf{Y} - \beta \mathbf{X})' G (\mathbf{Y} - \beta \mathbf{X})\). coefficients derived variance estimator \(\hat{V}(\beta)\) quadratic form, decomposed interactions outcome regressor. Algorithmic Implementation: achieve high performance, function processes data using two-level nested loop covariate strata (groupW) instrument groups (group). heavy \(N \times N\) geometry matrices (projection matrices \(P\), \(M\), leverage-adjusted weight matrix \(G\)) pre-computed exactly per stratum. Furthermore, target inner products (\(P_{XY}\) \(P_{XX}\)) aggregated inline stratum loop avoid redundant passes data. Within instrument group, unique Leave-Three-(L3O) variance interactions (\(A_1\) \(A_4\) terms) evaluated using exact scalar algebra helpers. approach minimizes computational complexity \(O(N)\) group level completely eliminates redundant matrix allocations. returned coefficients correspond : $$= P_{XX}^2 - q \cdot C_2$$ $$b = -2 P_{XY} P_{XX} - q \cdot C_1$$ $$c = P_{XY}^2 - q \cdot C_0$$ \(P_{XY}\) \(P_{XX}\) UJIVE estimators cross-products, \(C_0, C_1, C_2\) variance components compiled via L3O adjustment framework.

title: Classify and Compute Confidence Interval Bounds — GetCItypebd
text: confidence set defined \(\{ \beta : \beta^2 + b\beta + c \leq 0 \}\). Depending sign \(\) discriminant \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\), set can take one four forms: Type 1: Bounded Interval (\(\ge 0, \Delta \ge 0\)). parabola opens upward real roots. CI closed interval \([\beta_{min}, \beta_{max}]\). Type 2: Disjoint Union (Donut) (\(< 0, \Delta \ge 0\)). parabola opens downward real roots. CI union two infinite rays: \((-\infty, \beta_{min}] \cup [\beta_{max}, \infty)\). Type 3: Real Line (\(< 0, \Delta < 0\)). parabola always negative. CI includes entire real line. Bounds returned placeholders c(-100, 100). Type 4: Empty Set (\(\ge 0, \Delta < 0\)). parabola always positive. confidence set empty, implying model rejected specified significance level \(\beta\).

title: Construct UJIVE Weighting and Projection Matrices — GetGP
text: list containing four matrices: G: \(N \times N\) UJIVE weighting matrix. P: \(N \times N\) full projection matrix \([Z, W]\). Z: \(N \times K\) matrix instrument indicators. W: \(N \times L\) matrix covariate indicators.

title: Construct UJIVE Weighting and Projection Matrices — GetGP
text: function constructs design matrices instruments (\(Z\)) covariates (\(W\)) based provided grouping vectors. creates dummy variable matrices \(Z_{ij} = 1\) observation \(\) belongs group \(j\). calculates standard projection matrices: $$P_Z = Z(Z'Z)^{-1}Z'$$ $$P_W = W(W'W)^{-1}W'$$ $$P = P_{[Z,W]} \quad (\text{Projection onto } Z \text{ } W)$$ UJIVE weighting matrix \(G\) computed difference "leave-one-" adjusted projection full set covariates: $$G = D_P^{-1}(P - \text{diag}(P)) - D_W^{-1}(P_W - \text{diag}(P_W))$$ \(D_P\) \(D_W\) diagonal matrices containing annihilator diagonals (\(1 - P_{ii}\)) respective projections. Note: function assumes resulting design matrices full rank.

title: Compute UJIVE Signal Component (Stratified Design) — GetLM
text: function implements estimator signal component \(S\) stratified design: $$S = \sum_{s} e_s' [ U(P_{Q,s}) - U(P_{W,s}) ] X_s$$ Within stratum \(s\): \(P_{Q,s}\) projection onto instrument groups. \(P_{W,s}\) projection onto stratum intercept (local mean). \(U(P)\) denotes projection matrix diagonal elements removed, rescaled inverse annihilator diagonal \((1 - P_{ii})^{-1}\). corresponds numerator terms (\(P_{XY}, P_{XX}\)) test inversion designs discrete controls. Algorithmic Implementation: ensure high performance low memory overhead large datasets, function computes projection transformation \(G_s X_s\) using strictly \(O(N)\) vector operations. computes group means via optimized aggregation, derives diagonal leverage adjustments inline, directly applies leave-one-transformation without ever constructing dense \(N \times N\) projection matrices.
